rules.text: Items eligible for returns are accepted within 60 days of purchase.
rules.quote: Items eligible for returns are accepted within 60 days of purchase.

rules.category: electronic merchandise, grooming tools, filters and pumps, non-prescription pet medications and vitamins, ThunderShirts and calming products, flea and tick products
rules.text: A valid receipt is required to return or exchange certain items valued at $10 or more.
rules.quote:
A valid receipt is required to return or exchange the following items valued at $10 or more:

*   Electronic merchandise (including collars, fencing, and training products)
    
*   Grooming tools
    
*   Filters and pumps
    
*   Non-prescription pet medications and vitamins
    
*   ThunderShirts and calming products
    
*   Flea and tick products
rules.reviewNote: The summary omits the specific item categories listed in the quote, making it less precise and potentially misleading about which items require a receipt.

rules.category: prescription medication products, special order items
rules.text: Prescription medication products and special order items are not eligible for return.
rules.quote:
The following product types are ineligible for return:

*   Prescription medication products
    
*   Special order items (e.g.: personalized, embroidered, embossed, engraved products)

rules.category: in-store purchases, buy online pickup in store orders, same day delivery orders, third party delivery app orders
rules.text: Certain order types are not eligible for mail return and must be returned to a PetSmart store.
rules.quote:
The following are not eligible for mail return, and must be returned to a PetSmart store:

*   In-store purchases
    
*   Buy online pickup in store orders
    
*   Same day delivery orders
    
*   Third party delivery app orders (Doordash, Instacart, Uber, Shipt, Skip, etc.)

rules.text: A valid receipt is required to return or exchange any PetSmart services purchased online.
rules.quote: A valid receipt is also required to return or exchange any PetSmart services purchased online.

rules.text: Proof of purchase is required for returns and exchanges within 60 days; returns without proof are subject to approval and require valid government-issued ID.
rules.quote: Bring the item in its original packaging, in new or sellable condition, and proof of purchase (e.g., order confirmation, order ID, or pack slips) to any PetSmart store within 60 days of purchase. Subject to exclusions below.
rules.reviewNote: The summary adds that returns without proof are subject to approval and require valid government-issued ID, which is not stated in the quote.

rules.text: Online returns are refunded to the original payment method or e-gift card depending on payment type.
rules.quote:
Refund Method for Online Returns

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Original Payment Method** | **Refund Method** |
| Credit or Debit Card | Original Card |
| Gift Card | E-Gift Card |
| Other non-credit card payment (ApplePay, Paypal, Afterpay, etc) | Original form of payment |

rules.text: Refunds may take 3-5 days to appear on your credit card statement or original payment method transaction history.
rules.quote: Refunds may take 3-5 days to appear on your credit card statement, or original payment methods transaction history.

rules.text: In-store returns are refunded by cash, original card, merchandise return card, or cash after waiting period depending on payment type.
rules.quote:
Refund Methods

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Original Payment Method** | **Refund Method** |
| Cash | Cash |
| Check | Merchandise return card, or cash after a 10-day waiting period |
| Credit Card | Original Card |
| Debit Card | Cash |
| Gift Card | Merchandise return card |
| Other non-credit card payment (ApplePay, Paypal, Afterpay, etc) | Merchandise return card |

rules.text: For exchanges, any positive balance will be refunded using the original form of payment when applicable.
rules.quote: For exchanges, any positive balance will be refunded using the original form of payment when applicable.
